notes.text: The page starts an inverse construction by asking for a T-groupoid Lambda, an action of the unresolved E/Sigma group on (T,Lambda), and a faithful functor to the stated one-object groupoid of universal covers of capital Pi equal to covered Pi. The opening insertion adds the datum of an abelian group T. A heavily cancelled qualifier after T-groupoïde is retained only as doubtful connexe. The codomain ends with the statement that its automorphisms are lower-case pi. This is an account of the written data, not a proof of the construction.

The author defines the object set, whose tau/T glyph remains unresolved, as Ob Lambda and describes it as an E/Sigma set. For the explicitly quantified pair t,t', the page writes an injective homomorphism from Isom_Lambda(t,t') to pi, labels the Isom expression by pi_(t,t') below an underbrace, and states compatibility with composition. Fidèle is double-underlined, injectif singly underlined. The connector has a definite left hook but an uncertain small right head.

The last paragraph begins On a exprimé and restates the datum of a faithful functor Lambda into angle-bracket pi. A bracket then calls for a family of subgroups pi_t and for empty sets or bitorsors under pi_(t') and pi_t. The leading Mais and a possible on are cancelled. The final words promise to introduce les op. de and stop there; no continuation is supplied from another page.

The light pencil numbers 12 at the upper right and 23 at the lower left are both transcribed. Their hand is unknown; the use of the page-number macro records the written values and does not establish authorship of either number. No other marginal text or independent drawing is present.

M0704 is removed because no independent two-word passage can be located after the completed opening words; the nearby large curve is the attachment call of the abelian-group insertion. The two marks before un seul objet remain à/colon. The object-set bracket is transcribed with its comma before the closing bracket and without a compound hyphen at the E/ens manuscript line break. No articles, abbreviation points or ellipses have been added to complete the grammar.

raw_difference_disposition: All packet C/H differences and every visible text, mathematical sign, index, underline, cancellation, insertion, diagram and pagination element were inspected. Literal C/H excerpts were checked programmatically against this packet, and final excerpts against the candidate. Alphabet choices are included as requested; E/Sigma-only rows are low confidence and non-consequential, and tau/T encoding rows are medium and non-consequential. Mark decisions use only original IDs M0704 and M0705; new doubts are confined to remaining_doubts. Pure macro syntax, H editorial page-note wording, and raw commas produced by spacing macros are excluded from material rows. The original and each native half were actually viewed once; an earlier truncated original-image emission was not counted as inspection. Seven distinct open-locus crops were each viewed once. No OCR, web research or TeX compilation was used.

main_review.outcome: Accepted after all seven reader crops and six main crops. M0704 has no separately localizable ink after donnons-nous; M0705 first reading. Six doubt groups retained; connector alternatives made explicit.
